item.title: New Survey Highlights Gaps in AI‑Driven Data Center Energy Optimization
item.description:
New Survey Highlights Gaps in AI‑Driven Data Center Energy Optimization

Data centers are increasingly optimized by artificial intelligence and, at the same time, increasingly loaded by it. A newly submitted paper systematically surveys the literature, uncovers methodological gaps, and proposes a unifying framework.

🔍 Overview

  • Title: Artificial Intelligence for Energy Optimization in Data Centers (submitted 3 Sep 2026).
  • Scope: Examines the disconnect between control‑oriented studies (which treat workload as exogenous) and sustainability studies (which treat infrastructure as a fixed multiplier).
  • Method: Screened ~194 papers via a documented protocol, fully coded 63 papers, and derived statistics and a reporting schema.

📊 Key Findings

  • Study composition: 28 primary control‑oriented studies identified.
    • 18 validated only in simulation.
    • 5 reached physical hardware or a production facility.
    • None accounted for water withdrawal or embodied carbon.
  • Performance reporting: Savings intervals across four technique families overlap almost completely, preventing the field from ranking methods.
  • Identified gaps: Ten recurring gaps were scored for consequence and tractability.

🛠️ Proposed Framework – CLEAR‑DC

CLEAR‑DC is an architectural and methodological proposal (not a trained system) that:

  • Couples a control‑policy branch to a workload‑demand branch via an explicit elasticity term.
  • Outputs net benefit rather than direct benefit.
  • Emits a schema‑conformant record covering:
    • Energy
    • Carbon
    • Water
    • Embodied share
    • Validation venue
  • Serves as a reporting schema derived from the corpus analysis.

📑 Contribution

  • The primary empirical contribution is the corpus analysis and the reporting schema derived from it.
  • All coding sheets, derived statistics, and result artifacts are made available at the provided URL.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Highlights the lack of holistic sustainability metrics in current AI‑driven data‑center optimization research.
  • Provides a structured pathway for future studies to capture comprehensive environmental impacts.
  • Offers a common reporting format that can improve comparability across techniques.

Submitted by Summaiya Unnisa Begum on 3 Sep 2026 (v1, 26 KB).

#AI #DataCenters #EnergyOptimization #Sustainability

Source: Artificial Intelligence for Energy Optimization in Data Centers

item.title: Solidcore Resources Upgraded to B Rating and Retains Prime ESG Status
item.description:
Solidcore Resources Upgraded to B Rating and Retains Prime ESG Status

Solidcore Resources plc announced that its ISS STOXX ESG Corporate Rating has been upgraded from B‑ to B, while the company continues to hold “Prime” status, positioning it among the industry leaders worldwide.

🔍 Overview

  • ISS STOXX ESG Corporate Rating upgraded to B (from B‑).
  • “Prime” status retained, which exceeds the sector‑specific ESG threshold for mining.
  • Ranking in the top decile of the Mining & Integrated Production industry.
  • Performance Score of 59 with a “Very High” transparency level (as of 28 August 2026).

📈 ESG Rating Details

  • ISS STOXX ESG Corporate Rating uses a twelve‑point scale from A+ (excellent) to D‑ (poor).
  • Assessment is based on roughly 100 industry‑specific indicators selected for materiality from a pool of more than 700 indicators.
  • “Prime” status is granted to companies whose ESG performance meets or exceeds a sector‑specific threshold; for mining, the highest Prime threshold applies.

🏆 Rankings & Scores

  • Top decile of the Mining & Integrated Production industry.
  • Overall Performance Score: 59.
  • Transparency level: “Very High.”
  • S&P Corporate Sustainability Assessment score: 63, placing Solidcore in the top 10 % of mining companies worldwide.
  • CDP disclosure grades: “B” for Water Security, “B” for Supplier Engagement, “C” for Climate Change.

📣 Company Statement

“This upgrade reflects the sustained efforts of our senior management and teams across all our operations to embed responsible business practices throughout the Company. Retaining ‘Prime’ status well above the sector threshold is an important independent validation of our sustainability management systems and our commitment to transparency towards investors and other stakeholders.” – Michael Vasilev, Head of Sustainability Reporting, Solidcore Resources

🏢 About Solidcore Resources

  • Leading gold producer registered in the AIFC, Kazakhstan.
  • Listed on the Astana International Exchange.
  • Operates two producing gold mines and a major growth project (Ertis POX) in Kazakhstan.

🏢 About ISS STOXX

  • Leading global provider of research, analytics, and technology solutions for institutional investors and companies.
  • Covers corporate governance, sustainability, cyber risk, and fund intelligence, as well as market indices under the STOXX and DAX brands.
  • Majority‑owned by Deutsche Börse Group and serves clients worldwide.

All forward‑looking statements in the source release are accompanied by standard risk disclosures and are not guarantees of future performance.

#ESG #Sustainability #Mining #ISSSTOXX #CorporateRating

Source: Solidcore upgraded to “B” rating by ISS Stoxx

item.title: The AI Report 2026 explores AI adoption in fashion
item.description:
The AI Report 2026 explores AI adoption in fashion

The AI Report 2026 has been released, offering insights into AI’s role in the fashion industry through interviews, surveys, and industry perspectives.

📖 Overview

The AI Report 2026 is essential reading for anyone interested in AI for fashion. It includes profiles and exclusive interviews with 17 AI companies, stories and opinions from 12 different industry perspectives, and real survey feedback from around 100 voices from every level of fashion.

🧩 Key details

  • The report addresses the tension between adopting AI and questioning its planetary, human, and ethical costs.
  • It highlights the industry’s reliance on fast-paced, automated systems, overproduction, and overconsumption, while exploring the shift toward agentic decision-making.
  • The report features survey data and industry-wide perspectives on AI adoption.

💡 Why it matters

  • The report provides a platform for discussing AI’s relationship with people, planet, and production in fashion.
  • It encourages reflection on what work can be done by AI and what should remain human-centric.
  • The report underscores the need to balance AI’s opportunities with its potential trade-offs.

#AI #fashion #sustainability #industryreport #AIadoption

Source: Calculating The Cost Of A Prompt
